users.notes: name and email are optional (empty). avatar is 0 (first letter of the username) or a preset picture 1..8 drawn by the frontend. The three profile columns are added to older databases at startup. language is the interface language, fa or en.

columns.owner_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

boards.notes: A user can own any number of boards. Access is through board_members.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

board_members.notes: role is owner|member. The owner manages the board and its members; members edit cards, columns and labels.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

columns.notes: Five rows per board, created with the board. Only title changes.

columns.column_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES columns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL
columns.assignee_id: INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cards_column ON cards(column_id, position)
cards.notes: position is 0..n-1 within a column, rewritten on every insert, move and delete. due_date is 'YYYY-MM-DD'; priority is low|medium|high; assignee_id must be a member of the card's board. These three are optional (NULL) and are added to older databases at startup. Labels are in card_labels. created_at and moved_at (last change of column) are UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', used for the weekly report; NULL for cards from before they existed.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.name: TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''

labels.notes: Board-level labels like Trello; name may be empty. color is red|orange|yellow|green|blue|purple. Every board starts with one unnamed label per color.

columns.card_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.label_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES labels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

card_labels.notes: A card can have any number of its board's labels.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

chat_messages.notes: Each user's conversation with the assistant on a board, oldest first by id. role is user|assistant. Only completed turns are stored. Leaving a board deletes that user's messages on it. proposal (JSON, assistant replies only): operations, changes (Persian descriptions), status pending|applied|rejected|undone; once applied also before (the board's rows before the change) and after (a fingerprint), for undo. Added to older databases at startup. New proposals also have items: each change as {type, params} for any language.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.user_id: INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

activity.notes: Every change to a board with who, a Persian summary and when. via is 'assistant' for applied proposals. Deletions of cards, columns (with their cards) and labels keep the removed rows in data (JSON) so they can be restored once (restored = 1). params (JSON) holds the names in the change so the client can word it in any language; summary is the Persian sentence, shown for entries recorded before params existed.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.actor_id: INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

indexes: idx_notifications_due UNIQUE (user_id, kind, card_id, due_date) WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL
notifications.notes: kind is assigned, card_updated, card_moved, card_deleted, added_to_board, removed_from_board, board_deleted, due_soon or overdue. params (JSON) holds the names for wording. board_id and card_id have no foreign key so notifications outlive deleted boards and cards. Due-date notifications (no actor) are made when the user reads notifications, once per card and due date.

api_board_shape.description: GET /api/boards/{id} and the AI prompt use the frontend BoardState shape. Database ids are exposed as prefixed strings (board-, col-, card-, label-) so ids of different kinds never collide. assignee is a member's username.
